Chapter 273: Dragon Subjugation
(2)

And that wasn’t all.

[Devourer Rune stacks reached 100!]

[Bonus effect: Strength and body size increased by 10%.]

His height, originally 180 cm, now approached 2 meters.

A glance at his status screen showed that his Strength stat had also
increased by 10%.

‘I’ve grown a bit taller, but it’s not inconvenient.’

He was no longer a below-average-height adult.

Since his physical changes applied to reality as well, his real height, once
165 cm, had likely exceeded 180 cm.

Yet he felt no particular emotion about it.

The real gain here was the stat increase.

At that moment, a mercenary at the front pointed ahead.

“Captain! We found it! The cave where the evil Black Dragon resides!”

“All right. Everyone, proceed with caution!”

With 21 NPCs in tow, Ryu Min stepped inside.

And a notification appeared.

[You have entered the Black Dragon’s Lair.]

[The overwhelming stench of death constricts your lungs.]

[Penalty: All stats reduced by 25%.]

A massive penalty.

But to Ryu Min, it didn’t matter.

‘Even with reduced stats, the dragon will still die in one hit.’

The mercenaries illuminated the cave with magic as they carefully
advanced in a single file.

‘They should hurry up. There’s no need to walk this slowly.’

Contrary to their concerns, nothing appeared near the entrance.

They had to go deeper before encountering any enemies.

The dragon’s gatekeepers.

Sure enough, after walking for quite a while, a thunderous roar echoed
through the cavern.

“KRUOOOHHH!”

“Hiiik! It… it appeared!”

Dark Ogres.

Monsters twice as strong as regular Ogres, which were already considered
among the strongest land monsters.

Technically, they were boss-level creatures.

But compared to the real boss of this place, they were nothing more than
gatekeepers.

“Everyone, attack!”

“WAAAAAHHH!”

All 21 mercenaries charged at a single Dark Ogre.

To be fair, they were skilled—after all, they were a dragon subjugation
team.

‘If they were players, they’d be around level 60?’

But even at that level, they didn’t stand a chance.

At best, they could only stall the Dark Ogre’s movements.

‘In the end, I have to step in.’

Ryu Min’s involvement would make things much easier.

“KRUOO—KUGH!”

Even with a 25% stat reduction, Ryu Min’s stats were still in the hundreds
of thousands.

On top of that, thanks to the Yin-Yang Rune, his damage output was
doubled.

A single normal attack, enhanced by magic damage, was enough to finish
off a Dark Ogre.

[Dark Ogre defeated!]

[Title effect: EXP increased by 1.5x.]

[Devourer Rune effect: EXP and gold increased by 2x.]

[Devourer Rune: Gained 10 stacks and 2 stat points.]

[Total Devourer stacks: 110]

[EXP +0.95%]

[Gold +40,000]

[Additional Gold +20,000]

[Current Kill Count: 21/100]

[Slaughter Rune effect: All stats +21%]

[100m radius: 5 enemies detected.]

[One-vs-Hundred Rune effect: All stats +5%]

There were four more Dark Ogres nearby.

After quickly dealing with them, Ryu Min finally arrived before the Black
Dragon.

“T-that… that’s…!”

“T-the Dragon of Death…!”

A massive cavern.

A space where light could not reach—pure darkness.

And from within that darkness, two glowing red eyes, sharp as a serpent’s,
gleamed.

[Foolish humans, your guts must be spilling out of your bodies with fear.
How dare you trespass into my domain?]

The Black Dragon’s voice resonated directly into their minds.

It seemed to communicate in the same manner as angels—transmitting its
thoughts via telepathic waves.

‘Well, not that I care.’

Ryu Min, alone, stepped forward with his scythe in hand.

The mercenaries, who had been trembling in fear, stared blankly at his back.

[I am the Death Dragon, Karsainox. Now that you have intruded into my
domain, you should abandon all hope of leaving alive—]

The dragon suddenly stopped mid-sentence.

Its gaze lowered.

A mere human, standing less than a speck in size compared to its 20-meter-
long body, was fearlessly standing right before it.

“Since my stats are reduced, I should use a skill to ensure a clean kill.”

Speaking in an eerily calm voice, as if he were facing nothing more than an
insect.

It was laughable.

[Such an insignificant worm, not even worth the Ogres I crushed beneath
my claws, dares to—]

But before the dragon could finish its words, it noticed something.

A powerful energy gathering at the tip of Ryu Min’s scythe.

The force was unlike anything it had encountered before.

For the first time, the dragon felt a hint of fear.

Because the energy was far beyond its comprehension.

“Judgment of the Heavens.”

The pitch-black cave was suddenly flooded with an explosion of radiant
light.

A technique once wielded by Raguel, the 5th-ranking Archangel.

Two massive beams of light slashed through the darkness in an X-shape.

BOOOOOOM!

“UAAAAARGHHH!”

“K-KUHHH!”

The cave trembled violently as if an earthquake had struck.

The mercenaries were utterly shaken.

But what came after was even more shocking.

“T-the… the dragon…?”

“It’s… gone…?”

“Where did it go…?”

The massive chamber, which had been filled with the dragon’s enormous
body, was now empty.

No corpse.

No blood.

Nothing remained.

The Black Dragon had been completely obliterated by that single attack.

[Black Dragon Karsainox has been defeated!]

[Title effect: EXP increased by 1.5x.]

[Devourer Rune effect: EXP and gold increased by 2x.]

[Devourer Rune: Gained 100 stacks and 20 stat points.]

[Total Devourer stacks: 250]

[EXP +9.52%]

[Gold +400,000]

[Additional Gold +200,000]

[Current Kill Count: 26/100]

[Slaughter Rune effect: All stats +26%]

[‘Condensed Aether’ acquired.]

[‘Dragon Scale’ acquired.]

[‘Dragon Horn’ acquired.]

[‘Dragon Tooth’ acquired.]

[‘Blueprint: Aura of Death’ acquired.]

[You are the first player to slay a dragon.]

[Title ‘Dragon Slayer’ acquired.]

[First-time Dragon Kill Reward: ‘Dragonslayer’s Necklace’ obtained.]

[First-time Dragon Kill Reward: ‘Rune of Memory’ obtained.]

[The acquired runes have been automatically inscribed into your body!]

Chapter 274: A Never-Before-Seen
Item (1)

A flood of reward messages filled the screen.

With just a single skill usage, an overwhelming number of notifications had
appeared.

‘Makes sense. I did just take down a dragon, after all.’

Some might see this as excessive, but this was no ordinary opponent—it
was a dragon.

Even a party of max-level players would struggle to take one down.
Dragons were the ultimate boss monsters, nearly impossible to defeat
before reaching max level.

In other words, slaying a dragon in Round 17—before reaching the level
cap—was supposed to be impossible.

‘Since I’m the first to do it, it’s only natural that the rewards are abundant.’

Ryu Min glanced over the reward messages with a familiar gaze.

After all, these were the same rewards he had received in previous
regressions.

[Title – Dragon Slayer]

Acquisition Condition: Awarded for being the first to slay a dragon.

Effect: Doubles all stats when fighting dragon-type enemies. Monsters
instinctively fear the holder.

To Ryu Min, this title was practically useless.

He had no intention of hunting dragons in the future, so what good was a
stat boost against them?

‘At best, the fear effect might make hunting other monsters easier… but I
won’t be hunting anymore anyway.’

Since Ryu Min had no need for it, the title was meaningless.

The same went for the rune he had received.

[Rune of Memory]

Effect: Grants perfect memory—anything seen once can never be forgotten.

With Ryu Min’s intelligence stat already absurdly high, his memory was
unmatched.

‘Still, I can’t exactly refuse a free gift.’

Rather than the title or the rune, something else caught his attention.

[Dragon Slayer’s Necklace]

Type: Necklace

Grade: God

Effect: All stats +50, skill damage +50%, all elemental damage resistance
+30%

Durability: 20,000/20,000

Usage Requirement: Master Rank or higher

Description: A token granted exclusively to the first Dragon Slayer. Crafted
from a dragon’s claw.

‘Finally, I got it—the God-grade necklace.’

Its effects were as overwhelming as its rank suggested.

‘The stat and skill damage boosts are great, but the elemental resistance is
the real game-changer.’

Even Ryu Min couldn’t dodge every attack.

If he ever got hit by an area-of-effect skill during a boss fight, things could
turn ugly fast.

‘In those situations, the extra resistance will be invaluable.’

It was a satisfying haul—but the rewards weren’t over yet.

Condensed Ether, dragon scales, horns, and fangs.

Thanks to his high Luck stat, he had obtained a large number of
miscellaneous materials.

Even if he didn’t know what they were for.

‘It’s not like I can recognize every material in existence.’

Hadn’t he received a pile of unknown materials when he last used the
Infinite Material Pouch?

‘I don’t need Condensed Ether since I have no use for more God-grade
items. As for these dragon-related materials… no idea where they’d be
used.’

It was a bit frustrating, but at least he had something to work with—a
blueprint.

A blueprint he had never seen before.

‘Death’s Aura? What’s this?’

[Blueprint: Death’s Aura]

Type: Consumable

Description: Contains six different crafting recipes for the Eternal-grade
item Death’s Aura. It is recommended to take notes before using it.

Ryu Min’s eyes widened.

It mentioned a grade he had never encountered before.

‘Eternal grade?’

Even without knowing for sure, it had to be higher than God-grade.

After all, the description of Refined Ether had stated it could be used to
craft items beyond God-grade.

‘Which means Refined Ether must be one of the required materials.’

Regardless, he had to craft it.

There was no downside to trying.

But before that…

Ryu Min turned his head.

He had to deal with the twenty-one pairs of eyes staring at him.

“Taking down a dragon in one hit…?”

“Th-That’s incredible, my friend.”

“Hey, how about working exclusively for our mercenary group? We’ll pay
handsomely.”

Without hesitation, Ryu Min shook his head.

He had no intention of working under NPCs.

“Not interested. Just give me my reward.”

“Ahem, well, if you insist…”

Moments later, the dragon subjugation rewards were distributed.

[You have completed the Subjugation Quest!]

EXP: +2.38%

Gold: +100,000

The rewards were meager, but he accepted them for one reason—so the
mercenaries would leave.

“We’ve given you the rewards, so we’ll be heading out.”

“I have some business to take care of. I’ll leave later.”

“Oh? Then take your time.”

The mercenaries departed, leaving Ryu Min alone in the cave.

Chapter 274: A Never-Before-Seen
Item (2)

The mercenaries departed, leaving Ryu Min alone in the cave.

Returning to base camp wouldn’t be a problem—retracing his steps would
lead him back to the warp device.

But first, he had crafting to do.

Without delay, Ryu Min used the blueprint.

The instructions had suggested taking notes, but he didn’t need to.

His intelligence was high, and the Rune of Memory guaranteed he would
remember everything.

With a soft shimmer, the scroll vanished, and golden text appeared before
him.

[You have used ‘Blueprint: Death’s Aura.’]

[You can now craft the Eternal-grade item ‘Death’s Aura’ using the
following recipe.]

[Main Material]

Dragon Scale

[Sub Materials]

Refined Ether

Condensed Ether

Demon’s Pendant

Demon’s Heart

Tainted Energy

Ryu Min’s eyes gleamed as he examined the materials.

‘I have everything…!’

As expected, Refined Ether was required.

And the dragon scale, along with Condensed Ether, had just been obtained.

‘The Demon’s Pendant was already in my inventory, and the Demon’s
Heart and Tainted Energy came from the Infinite Material Pouch.’

He had initially dismissed the heart and energy as worthless, but that wasn’t
the case at all.

‘Turns out, they’re incredibly valuable.’

Perhaps all the unknown materials from the Infinite Material Pouch were
meant for crafting Eternal-grade items.

Excited, Ryu Min placed all the materials into the crafting window.

If he hadn’t received the blueprint, he never would have known how to craft
it.

‘I wouldn’t have even guessed that dragon scales were the main ingredient.’

Realizing the importance of blueprints, he pressed the craft button.

[Crafting Eternal-grade item…]

[Due to the high-tier nature of the item, crafting will take time. Please be
patient.]

[Combining materials…]

[Analyzing user’s soul…]

[Synchronizing…]

A series of cryptic messages appeared, but Ryu Min wasn’t worried.

‘It already said it’ll take time because it’s high-grade.’

Instead, he waited with anticipation.

And then—

[Crafting complete!]

[You have created ‘Death’s Aura.’]

A new item appeared in his inventory.

[Death’s Aura]

Type: Armor

Grade: Eternal

Defense: 5,000

Effect: All stats +200, reduces enemy stats by 50% (for those classified as
enemies).

Durability: Infinite

Usage Restriction: Black Scythe (Soulbound)

Description: A soul-bound item that overlays itself onto the user’s soul
rather than the body. Cannot be transferred. Can be worn alongside other
equipment.

Reading the last line, Ryu Min’s eyes widened.

‘It can be equipped with other armor? Even with my God-grade gear?’

Testing it, he issued the command.

“Equip.”

Unlike regular armor, his existing equipment remained untouched.

Instead, an eerie yet familiar energy enveloped his body.

It was the power of an Eternal item.

‘This is insane…’

Ryu Min’s lips curled into a smile.

This was beyond expectations.

And there could be more…

Ryu Min’s excitement only grew as he processed the implications of this
new item.

‘If there’s an armor classified as Eternal, then there must be other types as
well.’

Weapons, helmets, gauntlets, boots—who knew how many more Eternal-
grade items could exist?

‘If I need Refined Ether for all of them, I should be able to make at least
one more.’

Of course, blueprints were required, and at the moment, he had no idea
where to find another one.

For now, the only option was to experiment—attempt different
combinations in the crafting menu and hope for a successful result.

It was a grind, but there was no other way.

With that in mind, Ryu Min started testing new recipes.

He placed Refined Ether as a base, then added various unknown materials
from the Infinite Material Pouch.

[Invalid recipe.]

[Invalid recipe.]

[Invalid recipe.]

[Invalid recipe.]

Failure after failure.

Despite countless attempts, nothing worked.

Eventually, even Ryu Min had to give up.

‘It seems like Condensed Ether is a necessary component…’

The first Eternal-grade item required both Refined Ether and Condensed
Ether.

If that pattern held true, then Condensed Ether was a key ingredient for
crafting other Eternal items.

‘I’ll have to wait until the round ends. Everyone gets Condensed Ether as a
reward, so I’ll obtain at least one more.’

For other players, this meant they would finally be able to craft God-grade
items.

Since God-grade crafting materials were relatively easy to find, his allies
would be fully geared soon.

But for Ryu Min, his goal was beyond that—he needed to push past God-
grade entirely.

He had discovered a grade no one else knew about.

‘If my Luck stat wasn’t this high, I might never have obtained the blueprint
in the first place.’

This was a direct result of slaying the Archangels and accumulating
transcendental stats.

A part of him regretted not hunting them down sooner, but there was no
point dwelling on the past.

‘It doesn’t matter. From here on, I just need to keep learning.’

With that thought, Ryu Min turned and began walking toward the cave exit.

Discovering an entirely new tier of power was exhilarating.

At this point, he wasn’t sure if he even needed to get stronger.

Was there even a point?

But he couldn’t afford to be complacent.

Because—

‘What if the number one Archangel is far stronger than I imagined?’

He was bound to encounter that foe soon.

If not in this round, then in the next.

And when that moment arrived, he had to be ready.

But fate had other plans.

Step.

Ryu Min froze in place.

A presence blocked his path.

[I’ve been waiting for you, Black Scythe.]

The moment he heard that voice, he instinctively understood.

The one standing before him—

Was none other than the top-ranked Archangel.

Chapter 275: Vs Michael (1)

The sky above the sky, the god of battle, the only hope, the highest-ranked
archangel.

Michael carried countless titles, but none of them could truly satisfy him.

‘In the end, I’m just another pawn moving at the gods’ command. There’s
no real difference between me and my subordinates in that regard.’

Even though his subordinates revered him as the heavens themselves,
Michael felt empty.

After all, it was just a league of their own.

He was well aware that they were nothing more than frogs in a well.

Perhaps that was why he yearned for something greater.

A once-in-a-lifetime feat—becoming a god.

‘But in the end, even that is a futile endeavor.’

From Remiel, who ranked 7th, to Gabriel, who ranked 2nd.

He had turned a blind eye to the deaths of his fellow archangels, using them
as sacrifices, but it was no longer possible to delay the inevitable.

‘And now, my turn has finally come.’

To personally kill the Black Scythe.

To extinguish with his own hands the greatest opportunity of his lifetime.

[Haa…….]

Michael let out a sigh without realizing it.

His plan to keep the Black Scythe alive until the 20th round and achieve his
ambition of becoming a god had come to an end.

‘No… strictly speaking, it’s not over yet.’

But for all intents and purposes, it might as well be.

The gods were watching from behind the scenes.

Nemesis, the goddess of vengeance, as well as an even darker god, were
pressuring him to bring in the Black Scythe immediately.

‘Is it truly impossible to delay this any further…?’

There were no more archangels left to send.

No more excuses to make.

If he failed to hand over the Black Scythe to the demon Grand Duke
Plunictos before the start of the 18th round…

‘Plunictos will find an excuse to manifest himself, and in the end, we’ll lose
the Celestial-Demonic War.’

Not only that, but he would also earn the wrath of Nemesis and the other
gods.

[Damn it, how did things end up like this?]

Looking back, it was all because of Gabriel.

— If we use the Demon’s Resurrection Book that we picked up during the
last Celestial-Demonic War, we can make the Black Scythe a sacrificial
offering. We don’t even need to act ourselves. We can use other players who
already hold a grudge against him.

Trying to buy time by following Gabriel’s plan had been the worst possible
move.

‘If only I hadn’t been swayed by his suggestion to use the Demon’s
Resurrection Book… things wouldn’t have spiraled out of control like this.’

But regret, no matter how early, was always too late.

The plan had failed, and as a result, Plunictos had grown displeased,
drawing the gods into the matter.

In a way, it was his own decision that had led to this disaster.

‘No… could this all have been Plunictos’s scheme from the start?’

Had he deliberately left behind the Demon’s Resurrection Book to give
himself justification to intervene?

Had he anticipated that the angels would use it and planned to use that as an
excuse?

‘Damn it! We fell for the demon’s trick. How could we be so foolish?’

Even as he clutched his head in self-reproach, nothing changed.

At this point, there was only one solution.

He had no choice but to subdue the Black Scythe and hand him over, as
Plunictos demanded.

Even if it meant postponing his ambition of becoming a god.

‘Losing the Celestial-Demonic War is not an option. If that happens, even
my current position will be in jeopardy.’

Becoming a god could wait. For now, he had to deal with the immediate
crisis.

With that thought, Michael looked down at the Black Scythe in another
realm.

Using the celestial orb that granted him clairvoyance.

‘To avoid unnecessary complications, I should strike when he’s alone…’

As he was waiting for the right opportunity—

As if the heavens themselves were aiding him, he saw the Black Scythe
leave his encampment alone.

‘Where is he going?’

Watching closely, he saw him head to a mercenary camp and then use a
warp device to enter a dragon’s lair.

‘He’s leaving the kingdom war to his allies and focusing on hunting
dragons instead?’

As expected of the Black Scythe.

Not a single moment was wasted.

Though he was nothing more than a lowly human, Michael couldn’t help
but feel admiration.

‘Well, it’s only natural. He wouldn’t have made it this far without that level
of effort.’

But this was as far as he would go.

Though he lacked Gabriel’s ability to foresee the future, Michael could
already tell.

That the Black Scythe would soon be kneeling before him.

‘And entering the lair worked out perfectly. There’s also a 25% stat debuff
in effect.’

Not that he needed the debuff to subdue him, but there was no harm in
taking advantage of his weakened state.

After watching closely, he found the perfect moment.

Having just defeated the dragon, the Black Scythe dismissed his
mercenaries and was checking the system alone.

‘Now’s my chance.’

Whoosh—

In an instant, Michael warped into the other realm, spreading his massive
wings as he waited inside the cave.

And finally, he came face-to-face with the Black Scythe.

[I’ve been waiting for you, Black Scythe.]

The moment he appeared, the Black Scythe’s expression shifted into one of
surprise.

Well, of course.

How could a lowly human ever anticipate the arrival of an angel?

Especially not one with twenty wings.

But the real surprise was on Michael’s side.

“So, you’re Michael.”

‘He… knows my name?’

And not just his name.

“The sky above the sky, the highest-ranked archangel.”

Frankly, Michael was astonished.

A mere insect knew about him?

[You must have coerced my subordinates for information.]

“Well, technically no, but believe what you want.”

At first, the Black Scythe had looked surprised, but now, his expression had
turned calm.

‘He can remain composed in front of me? Even archangels tremble before
me, yet he…?’

That smug smile irritated Michael.

“What’s wrong? Does my smile bother you?”

[…]

“Relax a little. A lowly insect should at least be allowed to smile in the
presence of such a noble being, right? Why let it get to you?”

Now, he was even mocking him.

Michael let out a hollow laugh.

[Hah… I was always curious about what kind of person the Black Scythe
was, but this… You’re nothing more than a lowly, insolent brat.]

“Yeah, yeah. But I don’t see why I should care about what a birdbrain like
you thinks.”

[…]

[Now I understand how the other archangels fell to you.]

‘They must have let their guard down after being provoked by his
nonsense.’

It was obvious.

The reason he was taunting so blatantly was clear.

‘He’s trying to make me drop my guard since he can’t win with skill alone.’

But Michael was different from the other archangels.

He wouldn’t fall for such a pathetic trick.

He had already seen through it.

‘Arrogant human. Does he think he’s special just because the system chose
him?’

He was wrong.

Up until now, he had simply been lucky enough to kill archangels.

Now that he faced an opponent beyond his league, his fate was sealed.

[Do you have any idea why I’ve come?]

“You’re here to kill me, aren’t you?”

[I won’t kill you. Just subdue you.]

“To do what, exactly?”

[You must face judgment for disturbing the heavens.]

“Judgment? And who the hell do you think you are to pass judgment on
me?”
